description:
Cause a noncreature artifact to enter the battlefield under your control, which will be an Equipment due to Dan Lewis if it isn't an Equipment already, causing Chishiro to trigger.
Resolve Chishiro's first ability, creating a 2/2 red Spirit creature token with menace.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature, creating a Blood token which will be an Equipment due to Dan Lewis, and causing Chishiro to trigger.
Repeat from step 2.
